name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump nominates Lee Greenwood's wife to serve as ambassador to Barbados
changes.summary: President Trump on Monday nominated Kimberly Greenwood, the wife of "God Bless the USA" singer Lee Greenwood, to serve as ambassador to Barbados and several other Caribbean countries.

changes.title: Blanche defends mail ballot changes, says election practices are being probed
changes.summary: Attorney General Todd Blanche fiercely defended the Trump administration's push to impose tighter mail voting rules, telling CBS News the DOJ is examining election practices in multiple states.

changes.title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump Administration Plan to Screen Mail-In Ballots
changes.summary: The Trump administration had asked the justices to allow a new Postal Service plan to screen ballots just weeks before the midterm elections.

changes.title: Elections Officials Breathe Sigh of Relief Following Court Ruling on Mail Ballots
changes.summary: Officials cheered the order blocking President Trump’s last-minute effort to change the rules on mail ballots, noting that some states had already mailed ballots.

changes.title: Don Jr.'s wife says Russian oligarch hosted post-wedding festivities as a "gift"
changes.summary: Bettina Anderson, wife of Donald Trump Jr., said their "dear friend" Umar Kremlev hosted two nights of festivities after their wedding in the Bahamas.

changes.title: This city led the way on reparations for Black people. Trump is trying to stop it
changes.summary: Evanston, Ill., became the first U.S. city to compensate Black people for historical discrimination. The Justice Department is trying to kill its program before other cities follow suit. (Image credit: Candace Dane Chambers for NPR).

changes.title: The Trump administration is set to eliminate a rule that curbs greenhouse gas emissions from power plants
changes.summary: The rule change a significant shift from efforts by Presidents Joe Biden and Barack Obama to combat climate change.

changes.title: Vance says Americans should not be scared of AI as calls for limits grow
changes.summary: Vice President JD Vance said the Trump administration is concerned about AI but wants to make sure it's regulating the technology smartly.

changes.title: Trump doubled down on backing a united Ireland, reigniting a divisive political issue. Here's what to know
changes.summary: Northern Ireland's status has been contentious since it remained part of the United Kingdom after most of Ireland gained independence from Britain a century ago.

changes.title: Kennedy Center board to propose new options for honoring Trump, according to court filing
changes.summary: The document proposes 10 options for adding the president's name to the building's exterior.
